items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: All of the Bob Pickett and all that old bunch up there, man.

ctx.x: I know on the records you made, you took a lot of solos.

Well, they asked for solos on them records, too, on them records, a certain part of it. But I never believed in solos that way. But how we used to do it a long time ago, when they'd turn it over to me, the point of thing you say, like me, and the drums would get on low and pedal, and they'll get to our bass and piano. See, when we had that, you understand? Well, that was the only solo that we would have to take. Well, after we had a special number we'd play, take and let the banjo or guitar or piano do so much on…
But you were on the downtown side of Canal Street, right?
